{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crynyd Award''' was given to pilots in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] for acts of conspicuous bravery during space-to-space fighting. It was named after [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]].
